{{Top}}
{{Youmay|about the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]].|[[Toast (ritual)/Legends|the ritual]]}}
'''Toast''' was the name given to toasted [[Bread/Legends|bread]]. Two types of toast were [[Mustafarian toast]] and [[Iktotch toast]]. The terms "toast" or "toasted" are also used as a slang term for killing a being with a blaster.<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="SWRPGRE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The name "[[Garindan/Legends|Garindan]]" was translated by [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher's]] protocol droid to mean "toast" in one alien language that was not [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] in origin.<ref name="ToMECEBTDT">{{StoryCite|story=Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In-universe toast is the same as real world [[Wikipedia:toast|toast]].
